second_pass: Every offset confirmed on Windows by the game's constructor (inlined in bg3.exe+0x3B6EE20) and its member-init helper bg3.exe+0x1853ED0, including the 24-byte strings at +0x48 and +0x60. The component slot is an 8-byte POINTER to this 0xA0-byte object (the creator stores the object pointer into the 8-byte slot): the generator must declare the component as a pointer to the class, not inline - that is why the validator saw 160 against 8.
